name: Topheth
brief: Site of pagan child sacrifice, south of Jerusalem
short: Topheth, located in the Valley of Hinnom (also called the Valley of Slaughter or Baca Valley) south of Jerusalem, was a site of pagan child sacrifice that was defiled by King Josiah (<ref="2Ki.23.10; Jer.7.31-32; 19:2, 6, 11-14; 32:35; Isa.30.33">2Ki.23.10; Jer.7.31-32; 19:2, 6, 11-14; 32:35; Isa.30.33</ref>).
